description: NaNdNb₄O₁₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmmm space group. Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₈ cuboctahedra, corners with four equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.82 Å) and four longer (2.83 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Nd is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₈ cuboctahedra, corners with four equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.59 Å) and eight longer (2.82 Å) Nd-O bond lengths. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ cuboctahedra, and faces with two equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.02 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Nd and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, one Nd, and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Nd and two equivalent Nb atoms.
